text:
eli: Heads-up, saw a sustained CPU spike on exporter-prod-usw2 around 02:07. Top shows lots of time in a spinlock inside the prefetcher.
eli: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/local/d/exports/exporter-cpu?orgId=1&from=now-1h
mira: Can you paste a sample profile or stacktrace? suspect lock contention but want data.
eli: paste: ```0000  thread: exporter-1  cpu% 98
  34.2%  exporter::prefetcher::lock_wait
  18.7%  exporter::serialize::encode
   9.1%  tokio::task::poll
   6.5%  sys::futex_wait
``` 
eli: spike coincides with a large span burst from a customer at ~02:05 (route-sidecar replay)
ben: Did we deploy anything touching prefetcher/batching last night? I rolled out a small change to collector batching windows at 01:50 but not exporter.
zoe: There was a tiny canary (#3421) that tweaked prefetch concurrency for kvcache at 00:58, applied only to canary pool.
mira: If it's a spinlock, reducing concurrency or changing lock type might help. Also we should add contention timing to the lock for telemetry.
eli: did a quick A/B locally: PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=16 vs 6
eli: results (local perf run, 1k spans/s): concurrency=16 -> exporter CPU p99 480ms, concurrency=6 -> 190ms
ben: That matches contention. Could be lock granularity too: single global prefetch queue.
zoe: Quick mitigation: throttle prefetch inflight by tokens (size-weighted) instead of by items. That avoids bursts from huge spans.
eli: here's a quick patch snippet I tested:
```
// before: global_prefetch.lock()
let permit = inflight_semaphore.acquire().await; // new
spawn(prefetch_worker(permit, span_chunk));
```
ben: Nice. For prod we should prefer a config toggle so we can canary at 10% traffic.
mira: Agreed. Plan: 1) ship non-breaking config toggle, 2) canary to 10% exporters in us-west, 3) collect cpu/p99/errors for 30m, 4) roll to 100% if stable.
infra-bot: Deploy request created: deploy/redwood/exporter@pr-4892 -> canary pool (10%)
eli: Kicking canary now. PR has PREFETCH_MODE=semaphore and PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=6 defaults.
eli: quick smoke (3m in): cpu p95 down ~22%, p99 down ~35%, no error increase. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/local/d/exports/canary-compare
ben: Can we also sample a flamegraph from one of the canary hosts? I want to ensure lock_wait is gone.
eli: uploaded flame: https://artifacts.redwood/trace/1746078185/flame.svg — lock_wait reduced to 4.3%
mira: Great. After 30m monitor window, if stable roll to 100% and follow up with an instrumentation task to add contention histograms to the span exporter.
zoe: Also file a follow-up to change prefetch gating to token-based by default in next sprint.
eli: Canary finished at 1746078280: metrics stayed stable, rolling to full. :thumbsup:
mira: Thanks team. I'll open a short blameless note in #postmortems and assign action items: add lock-timing, convert gating to token model, add dashboard panel for prefetch contention.
ben: Also add a test for large-span bursts in our load-tests so we don't regress.
zoe: Filed follow-ups: https://tracker.redwood/issue/CORE-827 (prefetch tokens), https://tracker.redwood/issue/CORE-828 (contention hist)
mira: Closing thread. If anything spikes, revert to PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=4 while we investigate deeper. :white_check_mark:
